resources.string: Email verification is required once to use this app. Your existing boards and drafts stay on this device. After verification, communication works offline indefinitely. Analytics is optional and separate.
I register as a representative (otherwise, for myself)
Explicitly request a new code for the same email
Email verified. Online session securely saved.
Request queued. This does not mean an email has been delivered. Check status; do not request another email while delivery is uncertain.
Enter the code if you received the email. Delivery is not guaranteed.
This request cannot open the app. If already verified but the response was lost, request a new code explicitly.
Start a new request / change email
Secure registration storage could not be opened or verified. Your boards have not been deleted. Retry opening secure storage; do not clear app data. If this continues, contact support.

Your local registration works offline indefinitely. If an online session expires or its refresh result is uncertain, verify your email again to restore the online session. This does not delete boards or change analytics consent.
Request not confirmed. Check your connection and retry the same request. No additional email is sent by a status check. If verification was consumed without a saved response, request a new code.

Off by default. With permission, send safe action types and completion results to metrics.nkolinka.ru. Never send email, speech text, board names, cards, images or recordings. Turning this off immediately stops collection and clears the local queue; an offline withdrawal is sent when connected.
The chosen permission or withdrawal is not confirmed by the server. Local collection is stopped.
Waiting for server confirmation. No collection until permission is confirmed and delivered.
A newer server preference was found. Collection is stopped. Choose your preference again explicitly to resolve the conflict.
